reviews.author: Choong woo Kim
reviews.text:
SLIT meaning
(Slit is a word that means a thin, fine line or gap. In clothing, it gives space to move freely and at the same time serves to fit the body better.) I looked it up.
The place introduced today is a place I happened to visit on the weekend while warming up and having a cup of coffee!

★Slit, located at the edge of the alley inside Hongdae Playground, is a very stylish and sophisticated place with a black and white concept.
I apologized and drank coffee before it even opened, but... It just suited my taste.
I tried Flat White and Sidamo coffee, and the price of the coffee is reasonable, but the taste of the coffee is the best. It is famous for its cakes. I regret going early and not being able to taste the cakes, but I will definitely bring a coffee-loving friend to visit next time.

reviews.text: I found it by chance while looking at a map and went there with a friend. The atmosphere felt like a terrarium-like exhibition?! It was a very calm and sophisticated place, and it smelled good! And the cake is so delicious that it drives me crazy👍👍👍 The cakes I saw before I went were either out of season or sold out, so I had the fig and blueberry basquecheek cake, and it was really crazy...🍰 The fig cake in particular melted as soon as I put it in my mouth, so my friend and I opened our eyes... It's a bit pricey, but when you try it, you don't even think about the price. It's the best cake I've ever had!!💗

reviews.author: Jay l
reviews.text:
SLIT. The cafe named Niche featured a very consistent interior. Designs meaning “gap” are hidden everywhere, from the foreground to the bathroom door. I was really impressed when I found the SLIT logo cut diagonally on the coffee bean card that comes with filter coffee.

It feels like you paid that much attention to detail. The concept is black color with various tones and textures. The two baristas at the cafe were also wearing all black. The fact that they are both model figures makes me feel like I am in a Tim Burton movie. Is this what it would feel like if Tim Burton opened a cafe in Hongdae?

Two cups of coffee, one from Guatemala and one from Ethiopia, were prepared, so we drank one cup each. Basically, both were not without acidity, but Guatemala had a very well-balanced taste. I could feel the sweetness of the dark chocolate and the nuttiness of the nuts. I actually don’t remember Ethiopia very well, but I still have a strong memory of drinking it and saying it was delicious.

At the front of the store where the bar is located, you can drink coffee while enjoying the daytime sunlight. While I was drinking coffee, a cat came into the cafe and started acting cute, so let's just say it's a sentiment that even stray cats recognize. The seat behind the speaker was a good place to talk while listening to sensible song selections as background music. Aside from the fact that the outside space is gravel and the chairs are a bit uncomfortable, there don't seem to be many places in Hongdae where you can enjoy an outdoor terrace like this.

Above all, there doesn't seem to be a cafe with this kind of sensibility yet in Hongdae. This place looks like it's going to become famous, so go there quickly.

reviews.text: I have visited the store in Tokyo several times, but it was late to visit the branch in Seoul. Although Fuglen's unique comfortable and sophisticated atmosphere was the same, I thought the sense of spaciousness was attractive. Above all, I thought the friendly attitude of the staff and the uniqueness of the cocktails were what set it apart. While the coffee felt like they were replicating the Nordic style as much as possible by using coffee beans directly from Oslo, the cocktails were refreshing in that they were constantly trying new things in addition to what you can taste in Japan. It's nice to have a bar where you can enjoy things comfortably.

The friendliness of the staff here is more impressive than the taste. Very friendly. There was a corner for two people, so there was no place to put my bags, so I was just putting them in the corner, when a foreign staff member suddenly appeared and gave me a hammock(?) for both of my bags. They responded very friendly, even when asking for the Wi-Fi password.
Because of the kindness of the staff, my liking for Fuglen has completely increased. Even though it is bustling with people, there is no distraction.
Although the price is a bit high, they are friendly so I just accept it.

I changed the latte to oat milk for a single shot, and it was so nice because I could drink it smoothly! If you want a strong coffee scent, two shots are recommended!
There was no decaffeinated menu, so I ordered pumpkin tea, and it had a subtle pumpkin flavor and sweetness that made it very comfortable to enjoy.

The staff is very friendly and the space is nice.

reviews.author: korean

I came across Fuglan by chance. The interior had the unique atmosphere of an old cafe, and the lighting and music went well together, giving a feeling of Northern European sensibility. The menu was a bit unorganized and felt like a menu from an old coffee shop, but it had its own charm. Perhaps because it was a Sunday evening, we were able to sit down right away without waiting, and the seats were pretty good.

When I ordered coffee, they explained the beans carefully, which helped me a lot in choosing the menu. I drank Yeni Ramus, and the first taste was quite impressive because it had a black tea-like aroma and sweet and sour acidity, but the more I drank it, the more I was disappointed that it left a bit of a bitter taste in my mouth, as if it was over-extracted when hot. I wondered if it would have been better if the extraction method had been refined a little more.

Nevertheless, the stability and comfort of the space itself was good, so I had a strong feeling that it was a good place to sit and spend time, regardless of the taste of the coffee. The furniture was generally comfortable, and there was no discomfort while sitting. Coffee tail was being sold at the bar, and I remembered it as a menu item that I would definitely like to try if I come back next time.

reviews.author: SungJin Hong
reviews.text:
I ordered and tried Costa Rica Sol Naciente Et-47 Honey Processing, which is on the drip menu.

To give a brief impression, the overall consistency was light and sub, and the notes when warm were like a proper mix of raspberry and blackberry, a bit of jasmine, and light chocolate. I think the nutty feeling was very minimal.

Afterwards, when the temperature drops, a bitter taste like black tea is revealed. However, there was one unique note that I couldn't pinpoint, and it felt like a light blue refreshing feeling and butter at the same time. I couldn't find the words in my head that reminded me of it, so I had no choice but to leave an unfinished note. I don't think I've ever felt this way from any coffee I've had before.

As I was drinking coffee, the owner gave me some Geisha Washed. Unlike Costa Rican coffee, the strawberry scent comes through directly, and the floral scent is a step higher, making it more bright. And Earl Gray was hidden deep inside. Which is better? If you think about it, both coffees have distinct personalities, so I don't think there was a difference between them.

Thanks to the owner's kindness and service, I enjoyed my stay :)

reviews.author: Ramona R.
reviews.text:
The Organic Cat Cafe is one of the most moving and inspiring places I've ever visited. It's not just a cafe, it's a sanctuary for forgotten souls. All of the cats here have been rescued from hardship, many of them disabled or in need of special care, but they radiate warmth and trust as they finally receive love and care.
I've read some of the negative reviews, and honestly, it's heartbreaking that they seem to have no idea what this place is all about. Cats are not sick or neglected, they are survivors. You've already been through enough hard times, and now you're surrounded by people who give their time and love to help you live a better life. When you look into your cat's eyes, you can feel how loved and safe they are.
It is clean, cozy and full of gentle energy. Sure, we might need an extra litter box or two for the cats, but that's a small thing compared to the good they're doing here. Every visit supports the shelter's mission: to rescue, heal, and protect animals that otherwise wouldn't have a chance.
If you value kindness and compassion, please visit us. Bring your friends and tell them, don't believe the bad reviews. This place is saving lives every day, and they deserve all the love and support they can get.

reviews.text: It's a good place to take care of cats that fall on the street. Some cats like to be petted, others like to play with and, of course, when fed. Some cats caught colds, but I think it was difficult to control this because there wasn't enough space or resources to separate sick cats from healthy cats.

It was really sad to see some of the cats abandoned, but we are grateful to the staff who run this place for providing a safe and warm home for all these kittens. Thank you to the kind people who have kind hearts for rescued cats. I hope that the cats can always live here, being petted, hugged, played with, and fed with food and snacks.

reviews.author: Alison Moore
reviews.text: A great cafe for cat lovers! It's not a "cafe" but rather a place that focuses on cats, and all profits go towards cat treatment, so don't expect cake or coffee (of course, cold drinks are also available). But the atmosphere is really comfortable, and there are plenty of hiding places for cats who want to be left alone. If you want a pet or just want to cuddle it, please come by anytime. These are really adorable kittens. A variety of cats with unique personalities are gathered here! There are many cats that have recently been rescued and are receiving treatment for diseases, so some kittens have runny noses or coughs, but they are all well cared for. As a cat lover, I really like this “cafe.” I don’t think you’ll get tired of it even if you spend all day on it! It’s well worth the 10,000 won!

The kotatsu is warm and cozy, and I grilled it myself.

It's delicious and a perfect winter retreat.

There are so many toppings and sauces to choose from, so it's hard to choose.

It was a great way to relax in the cold weather. Reservations are essential. Be sure to check the weekends with an eagle eye!

reviews.author: YOON
reviews.text: Making takoyaki is fun and delicious, but it seems a bit weird that after 10 minutes or so, the reservation is just canceled and processed as a no-show. There is no phone number for the store, and the bus is more crowded than expected. I wanted to contact them because it was blocked right in front of me, but there was no way and I barely got in. Wouldn't it be better to at least make a phone call? Weekend walk-ins seem to be rare, so you have to make a reservation on Naver in advance, and the Carbo Buldak was undercooked...

reviews.author: 天爽エイミー
reviews.text: It's a great place to study in a quiet, cozy atmosphere or to enjoy a snack when you're suffering from insomnia. It's one of the few places open from 7pm to 7am. (If there are few customers, it may close a little early, so it is recommended to arrive before closing time.)

address: 1st floor, Black Insomnia, 81 Wausan-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Korea

reviews.author: Michele Kim
reviews.text: I'm so surprised no one has left a review! Please come and visit! It was really nice to have almond milk in the strong, carefully brewed coffee. Almond milk is hard to find. It looks just as delicious as it looks in the picture. I found this by chance while walking in Hongdae. The weather was very hot, but I was able to cool off thanks to the iced coffee! They only sell drinks and no food, but if you want strong, delicious coffee, definitely come here. The young staff member who took our drink order was also very kind and patient. I will definitely come back next time! 🙌🏻💯👍🏻

reviews.author: Ying Yu
reviews.text: A cafe in front of Hongdae. Americano is really delicious. The crema is thick, and it only costs 2,000 yen per drink. The music is good, and if you go to the cafe right next door, you can see idols signing autographs.

reviews.author: Peter Hardy
reviews.text: There is this small, gem-like coffee shop right across from the Custom Nike store in Hongdae. The almond latte was really delicious. Highly recommended to anyone who wants delicious coffee.

address: 1st floor, Advance Coffee, 20 Jandari-ro 6-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Sawate C
reviews.text:
I was drawn in by the charming atmosphere. The drink quality is good and the price is reasonable. The espresso made with coffee beans blended in-house was really delicious. There was a bit of acidity, but it was flavorful and well balanced. The hot chocolate was good, and you could adjust the sweetness. I haven't used the bakery yet.
The atmosphere was lively and nice.
I think we could attract more customers if the baristas were a little friendlier.
